text: The test --debug-sql option now formats SQL queries with sqlparse.
suggestion_reason: The --debug-sql option changes the format of command output.

text: The list of common passwords used by CommonPasswordValidator is updated to the most recent version.
suggestion_reason: The validator's updated password list can change the validation result shown to a user.

text: The light or dark color theme of the admin can now be toggled in the UI, as well as being set to follow the system setting.
suggestion_reason: The admin's visible light/dark theme can be toggled.

text: makemessages command now supports locales with private sub-tags such as nl_NL-x-informal.
suggestion_reason: The makemessages command changes which locale identifiers can be used in localization setup.

text: The new robust argument for django.db.transaction.on_commit allows performing actions that can fail after a database transaction is successfully committed.
suggestion_reason: The transaction.on_commit call gains a robust argument that application code can use.

text: The DjangoDivFormRenderer and Jinja2DivFormRenderer transitional form renderers are deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Code using either deprecated form-renderer class should be reviewed.

text: The Django 4.2.x series is the last to support Python 3.8 and 3.9.
suggestion_reason: Supported Python runtime versions affect the deployed environment.

text: QuerySet.prefetch_related now supports prefetching django.contrib.contenttypes.fields.GenericForeignKey with non-homogeneous set of results.
suggestion_reason: ORM prefetch behavior changes for GenericForeignKey results.

text: DatabaseFeatures.supports_expression_defaults should be set to False if the database doesn't support using database functions as defaults.
suggestion_reason: Custom database-backend code must set the DatabaseFeatures attribute correctly.

text: The django.contrib.sitemaps.ping_google() function and the ping_google management command are removed as the Google Sitemaps ping endpoint is deprecated and will be removed in January 2024.
suggestion_reason: Calls to the removed ping_google function or management command need review.

text: Support for passing positional arguments to Signer and TimestampSigner is removed.
suggestion_reason: Signer and TimestampSigner calls can no longer pass positional arguments.

text: The django.test.RequestFactory, django.test.AsyncRequestFactory, django.test.Client, and django.test.AsyncClient classes now support the query_params parameter, which accepts a dictionary of query string keys and values. This allows setting query strings on any HTTP methods more easily.
suggestion_reason: Test code can pass a new query_params argument to the named request/client APIs.

text: "init_command" option is now supported in OPTIONS on SQLite to allow specifying pragma options to set upon connection.
suggestion_reason: SQLite connection OPTIONS can now include an init_command setting.

text: The default parallelism of the ScryptPasswordHasher is increased from 1 to 5, to follow OWASP recommendations.
suggestion_reason: A changed password-hasher parallelism default affects runtime configuration and resource use.

text: django.contrib.postgres.indexes.BTreeIndex now supports the deduplicate_items parameter.
suggestion_reason: The BTreeIndex option concerns the database index definition.

text: The value of a django.db.models.URLField now renders as a link.
suggestion_reason: A URLField value is now displayed as a link.

text: The new django.core.mail.EmailMultiAlternatives.body_contains method returns a boolean indicating whether a provided text is contained in the email body and in all attached MIME type text/* alternatives.
suggestion_reason: Application code can call the new body_contains method and inspect its boolean result.

text: django.utils.decorators.method_decorator now supports wrapping asynchronous view methods.
suggestion_reason: method_decorator can now wrap asynchronous view methods in code.

text: The minimum supported version of gettext is increased from 0.15 to 0.19.
suggestion_reason: The minimum gettext version is an environment/dependency requirement.

text: The new django.forms.TelInput form widget is for entering telephone numbers and renders as <input type="tel" ...>.
suggestion_reason: TelInput renders a different HTML input type for a form.

text: The querystring template tag now accepts multiple positional arguments, which must be mappings, such as django.http.QueryDict or dict.
suggestion_reason: A template tag's accepted arguments affect URL output in rendered templates; review this boundary with API/code.

text: Squashed migrations can now themselves be squashed before being transitioned to normal migrations.
suggestion_reason: The change concerns how squashed database migrations are handled.

text: Support for passing Python's legacy email email.mime.base.MIMEBase object to EmailMessage.attach() (or including one in the message's attachments list) is deprecated. For complex attachments requiring additional headers or parameters, switch to the modern email API's email.message.MIMEPart.
suggestion_reason: EmailMessage.attach callers using MIMEBase must move to MIMEPart.

text: The default scheme for forms.URLField has changed from "http" to "https".
suggestion_reason: The default URL scheme produced by a form field changes from http to https.

text: The new Aggregate.allow_order_by class attribute determines whether the aggregate function allows passing an order_by keyword argument.
suggestion_reason: The Aggregate class attribute controls whether code may pass order_by.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when serializing email alternatives or attachments due to named tuple mismatches (36309).
suggestion_reason: The bug affected serialization of email alternatives and attachments.

text: django.utils.html.strip_tags now raises a SuspiciousOperation exception if it encounters an unusually large number of unclosed opening tags.
suggestion_reason: strip_tags now raises a named exception for certain inputs; callers may need to handle it.

text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 that caused composite primary key introspection to wrongly identify IntegerField as AutoField on SQLite (36358).
suggestion_reason: Composite-primary-key introspection reported the wrong database field type.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused unnecessary queries when prefetching nullable foreign key relationships (36290).
suggestion_reason: Prefetching a nullable foreign key changed the ORM query behavior.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash of QuerySet.bulk_create() with nullable geometry fields on PostGIS (36289).
suggestion_reason: bulk_create with nullable geometry fields affects database writes.

text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where calling QuerySet.in_bulk() with an id_list argument on models with a CompositePrimaryKey failed to observe database parameter limits (36416).
suggestion_reason: in_bulk with a composite primary key affects query limits and ORM data access.

text: Although this does not directly impact Django's security model, it poses risks when logs are consumed or interpreted by other tools. To fix this, the internal django.utils.log.log_response() function now escapes all positional formatting arguments using a safe encoding.
suggestion_reason: The note points to both log output and downstream log-consumer safety; the guide does not clearly rank those areas.

text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where HttpRequest.get_preferred_type() did not account for media type parameters in Accept headers, reducing specificity in content negotiation (36411).
suggestion_reason: Accept-header handling changes the media type chosen for an HTTP response.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 where admin's filter_horizontal buttons lacked type="button", causing them to intercept form submission when pressing the Enter key (36423).
suggestion_reason: Admin form buttons changed what happens when Enter submits a form.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using OuterRef in the filter argument of an Aggregate expression (36404).
suggestion_reason: OuterRef inside an Aggregate filter affects ORM query behavior.

text: Fixed a log injection possibility by migrating remaining response logging to django.utils.log.log_response(), which safely escapes arguments such as the request path to prevent unsafe log output (2025-48432).
suggestion_reason: The note points to both response-log output and operational log safety; a reviewer should choose the first area.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.2 where the q parameter was removed from the internal django.http.MediaType.params property (36446).
suggestion_reason: The internal MediaType.params property lost and regained the q parameter.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused QuerySet.bulk_update to incorrectly convert None to JSON null instead of SQL NULL for JSONField (36419).
suggestion_reason: bulk_update changes whether None becomes JSON null or SQL NULL in stored data.

text: Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when performing an __in lookup involving a composite primary key and a subquery on backends that lack native support for tuple lookups (36464).
suggestion_reason: A composite-primary-key lookup with a subquery affects ORM query behavior.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.3 where Value(None, JSONField()) used in a django.db.models.expressions.When condition was incorrectly serialized as SQL NULL instead of JSON null (36453).
suggestion_reason: JSONField expression serialization changes SQL NULL versus JSON null semantics.

text: Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when validating a model that uses GeneratedField or constraints composed of Q and Case lookups (36518).
suggestion_reason: GeneratedField and constraint validation concern model data rules.

text: Added compatibility for docutils 0.22 (36535).
suggestion_reason: Compatibility with docutils 0.22 affects an installed dependency version.

text: FilteredRelation was subject to SQL injection in column aliases, using a suitably crafted dictionary, with dictionary expansion, as the **kwargs passed to QuerySet.annotate or QuerySet.alias.
suggestion_reason: QuerySet.annotate/alias callers expanding an untrusted dictionary into kwargs need code review.

text: Fixed a bug where using QuerySet.values() or values_list() with a ForeignObject composed of multiple fields returned incorrect results instead of tuples of the referenced fields (36431).
suggestion_reason: values()/values_list() returned the wrong shape for ForeignObject results; consuming code should be checked.

text: QuerySet.annotate, QuerySet.alias, QuerySet.aggregate, and QuerySet.extra methods were subject to SQL injection in column aliases, using a suitably crafted dictionary, with dictionary expansion, as the **kwargs passed to these methods (follow up to 2022-28346).
suggestion_reason: QuerySet callers expanding an untrusted dictionary into kwargs need code review.

text: The django.utils.archive.extract() function, used by startapp --template and startproject --template, allowed partial directory-traversal via an archive with file paths sharing a common prefix with the target directory (follow up to 2021-3281).
suggestion_reason: The archive.extract function and project-template commands are both named; code use and project setup are plausible first checks.

text: Python's NFKC normalization is slow on Windows. As a consequence, django.http.HttpResponseRedirect, django.http.HttpResponsePermanentRedirect, and the shortcut redirect() were subject to a potential denial-of-service attack via certain inputs with a very large number of Unicode characters (follow up to 2025-27556).
suggestion_reason: The affected interfaces are redirect response classes and redirect(); review calls that accept large untrusted inputs.

text: Fixed a bug in Django 5.2 where QuerySet.first() and QuerySet.last() raised an error on querysets performing aggregation that selected all fields of a composite primary key.
suggestion_reason: first()/last() on aggregate queries with composite primary keys affects ORM data access.

text: Fixed a bug where management command colorized help (introduced in Python 3.14) ignored the --no-color option and the DJANGO_COLORS setting (36376).
suggestion_reason: The change affects visible color in management-command help output.

text: Fixed a visual regression in Django 6.0 for admin form fields grouped under a <fieldset> in Safari (36807).
suggestion_reason: The note explicitly describes a visual regression in admin form fields.
